turns.comment: The command glossary advertises *cart* as working anywhere, but it was only wired at the menu/item steps. Here it fell into the quantity parser and came back as a parse failure — which also feeds the frustration ladder, so asking to see your own order twice got you offered a human agent.

turns.in: how much is it so far
turns.comment: Prose form too. Resolved only AFTER the step's own parse returns zero matches, so it can never swallow a real quantity phrase — whatever reaches it was already going to be 'I didn't catch that'.
Same gap at the notes recap, where free text is normally 'N: note'.
